user_problem: Teams need a feasible short allocation proposal from finite tasks and explicitly supplied resource slots.
unique_output: Task-to-slot allocation table, unmet constraints and unallocated tasks, without an optimality or staffing guarantee.
required_input: Task durations, eligible resources, time slots and priority rules.
critical_rule: Never overlap a resource or shrink supplied durations; flag infeasibility instead of inventing capacity.
nearest_existing_and_difference: vendor-demo-question-set proposes demo evidence; this checks generic finite task/resource slot feasibility.
acceptance_scenario: Two30-minute tasks and one40-minute slot on one resource cannot both fit; allocate one under supplied priority and preserve the other as unallocated.
